# Spec Intake Form

Use this form when receiving a new spec or feature request.

## Source

- **From**: (human, product doc, issue, Slack, meeting)
- **Date**: YYYY-MM-DD
- **Urgency**: low / medium / high / critical

## Classification

- **Input type**: new spec / spec slice / change request / new initiative / maintenance / harness improvement
- **Risk lane**: tiny / normal / high-risk

## Summary

(2-3 sentences: what is being asked for?)

## Scope

### In Scope
- (explicitly included)

### Out of Scope
- (explicitly excluded)

### Open Questions
- (anything unclear that needs answering before work starts)

## Affected Areas

- [ ] API routes
- [ ] Database schema
- [ ] Background jobs / queues
- [ ] UI / pages
- [ ] Auth / authorization
- [ ] External integrations
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Tests

## Story Decomposition

(List the stories this spec breaks into.)

| Story | Lane | Epic |
|---|---|---|
| (story 1) | (lane) | (epic) |

## Dependencies

(What must exist before this can start? What blocks if delayed?)
